core.me.details.title: Your details
core.me.details.intro: How the theatre names you. A change shows everywhere at once.
core.me.details.name: Your name
core.me.details.name-help: Your full name, as you would give it at the box office.
core.me.details.preferred-help: Leave this empty to be called by your name.
core.me.details.pronouns-help: For example she/her, they/them or he/him. Leave this empty if you would rather not say.
core.invitation.landing.title: You're in
core.invitation.landing.to: You have been invited to be {roles}.
core.invitation.landing.by: {name} has invited you to the theatre's site.
core.invitation.landing.plain: You have been invited to the theatre's site.
core.me.contacts.title: Emergency contacts
core.me.contacts.intro: Up to {count} people the theatre can ring if something happens to you while you are with us. Staff read them only with a reason, and you can see each time they did.
core.me.contacts.none: You have not given any emergency contacts.
core.me.contacts.name: Name
core.me.contacts.relationship-help: For example partner, parent or friend.
core.me.contacts.told: I have told these people that their details are kept here.
core.me.contacts.told-needed: Tick this once you have told them.
core.me.email.title: Email addresses
core.me.email.intro: The theatre writes to one confirmed address. Members' notices can go to another.
core.me.email.waiting: Waiting for you to use the link
core.me.email.remove-consequence: You will no longer be able to sign in with it or receive anything at it.
core.me.email.add-help: We send a link to it. It does nothing until you use the link.
core.me.email.sent: We have sent a link to {address}. Use it to confirm the address.
core.me.sign-in.title: Signing in
core.me.sign-in.passkeys-help: A passkey lets you sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of waiting for an email.
core.me.sign-in.none: You have no passkeys yet. You sign in with a link sent to your email.
core.me.sign-in.remove-consequence: You will no longer be able to sign in with it.
core.me.sign-in.app-help: For when your passkey is not to hand, such as on the box office laptop. An app like Google Authenticator, 1Password or Microsoft Authenticator shows a new six-digit code every 30 seconds. It never signs you in on its own: you still sign in by email first.
core.me.sign-in.app-qr: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
core.me.sign-in.app-cant-scan: Scan the code with the app. Can't scan? Type this key instead:
core.me.sign-in.app-added: Your authenticator app is ready to use.
core.me.sign-in.app-remove-consequence: Its codes will stop working. You can set it up again later.
core.me.sign-in.codes-help: If you lose your passkeys, a recovery code gets you back in. Each one works once.
core.me.sign-in.codes-none: Recovery codes come with a passkey. Add one first.
core.me.sign-in.codes-not-kept: These codes were made before they could be shown again. Make new codes to see them.
core.me.sign-in.new-codes-consequence: Your old codes will stop working.
core.me.sign-in.codes-kept: Your new recovery codes are ready to use.
core.me.sessions.title: Where you are signed in
core.me.sessions.intro: Each browser you are signed in on. Ending one signs it out the next time it is used.
core.me.sessions.end-consequence: That browser will need to sign in again.
core.me.sessions.end-this-consequence: You will be signed out here.
core.me.sessions.end-others-consequence: Only this browser will stay signed in.
core.me.sessions.others-ended: Every other browser is signed out.
core.me.data.title: Your data
core.me.data.unavailable: Downloads and erasure are not available yet
core.me.data.unavailable-detail: The theatre needs to say who to contact about personal data first.
core.me.data.download-help: Everything the theatre holds about you, in open formats, with a page that explains it. We email you when it is ready.
core.me.data.download-asked: We are making your download. We will email you when it is ready.
core.me.data.erase-help: Your name, addresses and everything personal are removed. We email you a link to confirm, and you can cancel until it runs.
core.me.data.erase-consequence: Once it runs it cannot be undone. Tickets and bookings stay in the theatre's records without your name.
core.me.data.erase-asked: Check your email and use the link to confirm the erasure.
core.me.data.state.requested: Waiting for you to use the emailed link
core.me.data.state.held: Waiting for something to be settled
core.me.data.cancel-consequence: Your account stays as it is.
core.me.data.expired: The download has gone. You can make another.
core.me.notifications.title: Notifications
core.me.notifications.intro: Choose which optional messages you get, by email and in your inbox. Messages about your own bookings, shifts and account always come.
core.me.notifications.none-help: Every message the theatre sends you is about your own bookings, shifts or account, so they all come.
core.notification-topics.credits.label: New credits
core.notification-topics.credits.descrip: When the theatre credits you on a production.
